answer: Because the timing is recorded against the jetty challenge, the relic audit can replay the echo history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 126 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2719 identities would post 699 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
